Origin and meaning

The name Logan has Scottish roots and means “little hollow”.

About the name Logan

A Scottish name of a highland clan, later a comic-book hero surname.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Logan suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
